author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕರ್ಮಚೀಲವ ಹೊತ್ತು ಭೂಮಿಗಿಳಿಯುವ ದೇಹ
ಧರ್ಮದಿಂದಲಿ ನಡೆಯೆ ಕೋಶ ಕರಗುವುದು
ಚರ್ಮರಕುತದಿ ಧರ್ಮವಿಳಿಯುತಿರೆ ಸಂಪದವು
ಮರ್ಮವಿದ ತಿಳಿದುನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The body comes down to earth carrying a sack of karma;
if you walk in dharma, the store will melt away;
when dharma enters your skin and blood, that is true wealth;
know this secret and walk on, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We are born carrying the load of past karma. Living by dharma dissolves it. When dharma becomes part of our very being, we are truly rich.
